About the job

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.  The IT Tooling team sits within IT Support & Services (ITSS) and builds the automations that power ITSS's own operations. Our in-house bot, Ask IT, deflects the majority of company-wide IT requests before they reach a human. Beyond that, we automate ITSS's core day-to-day workflows — ticket triage, access reviews, onboarding and offboarding — which employees experience as self-service. personal_details.label: Senior SDET | API & UI Automation | Java · Python · Microservices
personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: PNR Linking & SSR [REST Assured · ReadyAPI · BDD · AiDE] : Architected automation frameworks for airline domain; built 1000+ test cases cutting effort from 750 to 50 man-hours (93% reduction).
Order Bags [REST Assured · AiDE · E2E] : Leveraged Agentic AI (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated Kibana log analysis, issue reporting, and data quality validation pipelines; eliminated manual intervention and saved 12 hrs/week of QA overhead.
Drove shift-left testing practices using Azure DevOps and BDD Cucumber, reducing bug leakage to production across 3 airline microservice domains.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
